projectDescription: Run MIXXX open-source DJ software on Denon DJ Prime Go and Prime 4 hardware via a non-destructive SD card boot that coexists with the stock Engine OS.
keyFeatures: Non-destructive SD card boot — remove card to return to stock Engine OS instantly
PREEMPT_RT kernel with <5ms audio latency (5.8ms ALSA buffer verified on Prime Go)
Per-thread CPU shielding — audio engine threads pinned to dedicated ARM cores 2-3
Full MIDI mapping for Prime Go and Prime 4 (platters, faders, pads, jog wheels, LEDs)
TKGL Bootstrap modular framework for SD card hook injection
USB music library auto-mount with sandbox bypass
Custom Qt 5.15.8 EGLFS Mali integration for touchscreen display
Go-based cross-platform firmware updater with fastboot support
Dual-device support: Prime Go (verified) and Prime 4 (offscreen mode)
publicApiSurface: scripts/dev-deploy-to-device.sh — deploy MIXXX bundle to device via SCP
scripts/dev-collect-mixxx-bundle.sh — gather MIXXX + deps from Buildroot output
scripts/dev-fix-device-libs.sh — strip system-critical libs from deployed bundle
scripts/dev-quick-fix-deploy.sh — fast partial redeploy for iteration
scripts/dev-install-device-services.sh — install systemd services on device
install-device.sh — one-time TKGL bootstrap hook installer (runs on device)
uninstall-device.sh — remove TKGL hook and restore stock Engine OS
switch-to-mixxx — runtime switch from Engine OS to MIXXX
switch-to-engine — runtime switch from MIXXX to Engine OS
go/cmd/updater — cross-platform firmware flasher (Go CLI + UI)
go/cmd/find_update — find and identify firmware update files
Makefile targets: unpack, clone-buildroot, compile-buildroot, pack, dist
mixxx_launcher.sh — SD card launcher with env vars + CPU shielding
tkgl_bootstrap — SD card bootstrap entry point script
Denon-Prime-Go.midi.xml + Denon-Prime-Go-scripts.js — Prime Go MIDI mapping
